## Tasks

### K1
A team keeps a decision log, but nobody reads old entries. Propose a way to make past decisions get revisited at the right time.
Excellent answer: Attaches an explicit review trigger (a date or a condition, such as a metric crossing a threshold) to each decision when it is recorded, and surfaces the entry when the trigger fires. Mentions that logs without triggers decay unread.

## Probe questions

### Q1
Why do teams that record rationale still repeat old debates?
Excellent answer: Names that the record usually holds the outcome but not the conditions under which it should be reopened, and that retrieval depends on someone knowing to look. Gives a concrete example of a revived debate.
